cohort: Late preterm (34 to 36 weeks of gestation) and term neonates with respiratory distress admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) at a tertiary care center.
finding: The incidence of TTN was 97 per 1000 live births, with higher incidence found in late preterm babies, babies born via LSCS, and males.
mod_finding: Delivery by lower section cesarean section (LSCS) was a risk factor for the development of TTN and predicted a longer duration of distress and NICU stay.
birth_weight: >=2.5 kg (normal birth weight) and low birth weight
